name: Character Generator
description: Provides a token [charactergen:random] that generates a 10-character Crockford-base32 alphanumeric string, intended as an Automatic Entity Label value.
project_description: Character Generator is a small Token-module add-on that exposes a single custom token, [charactergen:random], producing a 10-character alphanumeric string from a Crockford-style base32 alphabet ('23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ', which omits easily confused glyphs like I/1 and O/0). It is designed to be dropped into an Automatic Entity Labels pattern so nodes get machine-generated labels such as registry numbers, reference codes, or tracking identifiers. The string is derived from the current time (day-of-year/year for the leading 4 characters, time-of-day-in-milliseconds for the trailing characters) with a small random offset added to the milliseconds; the maintainer notes there is no duplicate-prevention check. The module ships only a .module file (three token hooks plus one entity-type-build hook) and depends on the Token module.
